non_goals: No projection discriminator, no selector tuning, no semantic ranking, no helper/DSL revival, no repetition re-litigation.
note: This audit is the terminal Track-C measurement. Both branches resolved: repetition closed on reproduced low ceilings; projection closed on failed no-hindsight selectivity despite large oracle mass.
reopen_criteria: Reopen only on materially new evidence: (a) a different model/scaffold/task corpus measuring C0>=10% or C1>=20% under observation-granular visible-history-only rules; or (b) a preregistered no-hindsight selector achieving >=25% reduction at >=95% P0 recall on >=10 independent tasks of such a corpus. A large P2 oracle mass alone is explicitly insufficient.
